_s215e_owners_basis: 1.21.4's owner UUID members on 1.21.5's EntityReference owner (javap -c -p 1.21.4 / 1.21.5 class_6025, class_1321, class_1496; rt/CbOwners). AbstractHorse's getOwnerUUID / setOwnerUUID read and set the field 1.21.4's did (1.21.5 class_1496.field_55705, the layer's access widener). Overrides: 1.21.5 vanilla asks getOwnerReference where 1.21.4 asked getOwnerUUID (every OwnableEntity: TamableAnimal, AbstractHorse, a mod's own implementer, which 1.21.5 holds to getOwnerReference), sets TamableAnimal's owner through setOwnerReference and a horse's through setOwner(entity) where 1.21.4 called setOwnerUUID. A converted override's super call runs 1.21.4's body on 1.21.5's storage without a virtual call (superRedirects), so the override is entered once.

overrideHooks.basis: getOwnerUUID -> getOwnerReference: 1.21.5 reads every OwnableEntity's owner through getOwnerReference (javap -c 1.21.5 class_6025.method_35057, TamableAnimal / AbstractHorse callers); the override's UUID as the reference to it

TamableAnimal.setOwnerUUID -> setOwnerReference: 1.21.5's tame / setOwner / load set the owner through setOwnerReference where 1.21.4 called setOwnerUUID (javap -c both class_1321); the reference's UUID

AbstractHorse.setOwnerUUID -> setOwner(entity): 1.21.5's tameWithName sets the owner through setOwner(player) where 1.21.4 called setOwnerUUID(player's UUID) (javap -c both class_1496); 1.21.5's load writes the field directly (1.21.4 called setOwnerUUID there too: that path does not reach the override)
